title: Female-led firms in Japan hit record high, but remain below 10% – survey

blocks.text: TOKYO — The proportion of companies headed by women in Japan rose to a record 9.0 percent in 2026, marking the sixth consecutive annual increase but was still below 10 percent, according to a survey by credit research firm Teikoku Databank Ltd. The figure rose 0.4 percentage point from the previous year and doubled the 4.5 percent recorded in 1990. The survey, released Thursday, analyzed about 1.2 million companies nationwide as of October.
